description: This is a Spring Boot controller class handling fund transfer-related API endpoints, including sending a fund transfer request and retrieving all transfers with pagination.

classes.name: FundTransferController
classes.description: Spring REST controller for managing fund transfer endpoints, utilizing Service layer for business logic.

methods.name: sendFundTransfer
methods.description: Handles POST requests to initiate a fund transfer, logging the request and delegating to service layer.

methods.name: readFundTransfers
methods.description: Handles GET requests to retrieve all fund transfer records with pagination, delegating to service layer.
